name: A capability sequence on connected paths
description: Explain an onboarding or service journey in a compact diagram. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: The order of onboarding or service steps is the message.

props.title: A capability sequence on connected paths

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: The first stage and the outcome you promise appear together.

props.label: Outcome
props.placeholder: From idea to launch in a week
props.hint: Shows with the first stage at the start.

props.subtitle: A path connects four icons, one stage at a time. Use icons on a plain or transparent background.

props.label: Line 1
props.hint: Shows as the path reaches stage 2.

props.label: Line 3
props.hint: Shows as the path reaches stage 4.

props.subtitle: The whole path stays on screen with the outcome and the next step.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: A capability sequence on connected paths
value.objective: Explain an onboarding or service journey in a compact diagram.
value.direction: A continuous visual path communicates progression; one node is active at a time.
beats: 0–1.8 s: First node and the desired outcome appear together. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Outcome.
1.8–4.2 s: Path connects the first and second nodes. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Line 1.
4.2–6.6 s: Next node becomes active. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Stage icon 3, Line 2.
6.6–9 s: Final node completes the journey. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Stage icon 3, Stage icon 4, Line 3.
9–12 s: Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Stage icon 3, Stage icon 4, Logo, Outcome and call to action.
